subject.title: fix(security): close forged-marker sanitization bypass and harden web_search boundary

question: Should supported web-search providers be required to return JSON-serializable data at the core normalization boundary, with non-serializable results converted to `provider_error`?
rationale: The patch intentionally defines a fail-closed boundary contract for bundled and external provider output; accepting that compatibility tradeoff is a security and plugin-contract decision rather than a mechanical review conclusion.

options.title: Accept JSON-only boundary contract
options.body: Merge the fail-closed snapshot behavior after confirming supported providers only return JSON-compatible payloads.

options.title: Preserve selected non-JSON values
options.body: Revise the boundary to safely normalize a documented subset of supported non-JSON provider values before rejecting the rest.

recommendation.title: Accept JSON-only boundary contract
recommendation.body: Merge the fail-closed snapshot behavior after confirming supported providers only return JSON-compatible payloads.
